text:
What will you say tonight, poor solitary soul,

What will you say, heart, so recently withered,

To the very beautiful, the very good, the most beloved,

Beneath whose gaze you flowered again?


—We will employ pride in singing her praises;

Nothing equals the charm there is in her authority;

Her spiritual flesh has an angelic perfume,

And her eyes clothe us in the purest garments.


In the middle of night and solitude,

Or through the streets, surrounded by the crowd,

Her phantom dances in the air like a torch.


Sometimes she speaks and says: "I am beautiful and command

That for love of me you love only Beauty;

I am the Guardian Angel, the Muse, and the Madonna."

translation.title: What Will You Say Tonight, Poor Solitary Soul...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the soul's address to its beloved apparition as angel, muse, and Madonna.
